title: Assertio Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-29
summary: Assertio Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 29, 2026 announcing the extension of a tender offer deadline from April 8, 2026 to May 4, 2026 in connection with a merger agreement with Garda Therapeutics, Inc. and its wholly owned subsidiary Audi Merger Sub, Inc. The filing is under Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure.
key_points: Assertio Holdings reached mutual agreement with Garda Therapeutics to extend the tender offer deadline to May 4, 2026
The original merger agreement was dated April 8, 2026
The tender offer is for all outstanding shares of Assertio's common stock
Audi Merger Sub, Inc. is a wholly owned subsidiary of Garda created for the acquisition
The filing is categorized as Regulation FD Disclosure under Item 7.01
